Let's Talk About!


"Let's Talk About" is Back! Join Our English Speaking Sessions!

Dear NDHU Students,

Great news — Let's Talk About is back this semester!

Join us for this fun and interactive English-speaking activity hosted by the Language Center at National Dong Hwa University. We're super excited to kick off another round of fun, interactive English conversations just for you.

This program is all about helping you improve your English-speaking skills. You'll join engaging discussions on interesting topics with international PhD and Master students, giving you the perfect chance to practice speaking, share your ideas, and boost your fluency — all in a friendly, supportive online environment.

Stay tuned for more details, and don't miss out! We can't wait to see you there.
Let's talk soon! Let's talk about!

Participation in "Let's Talk About" will earn you NDHU Interdisplinary Autinomous Learning hours!
